'gobarjod g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgra dbyangasashes byar/'phags yul smra ba'i khyu mchog legs ldan 'byed/ / 'jam dbyangs mi gzugs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ / sku yi skye bar grwa sa che rnams su/ / rlung ltar grags pa'i nges/ don dge bshes che/ / dbu yi zur phud bregs pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ri dwags pags pa'i gos med snying rje'i gter/ / rdo rje phyag tu mi 'dzin gsang ba'i bdag / rnam gsum dbyer med bstan 'gro'i dpal du shar/ / mkhyen pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor snyim par bskyil/ / brtse bas ris med sems can gdul byar bsdus/ / nus pas chos srid zung gi 'khor los bsgyur/ / dregs ldan sa skyong mang bos spyi bor 'dzin/ / 'chad tshe gsung zur gcig gis gzhung brgya bkrol/ / rtsod tshe lung rigs phra mo'i rtse brgya 'bar/ / ljags rtsom tshig don rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng can/ / mkhas dgu'i rtsom rigs bye ma'i ri bor btang / / nan cin pe cin gnyis su zhabs sor 'khod/ / srid gzhung gsar rnying gnyis su bstan srid bskyangs/ / rgya bod gnyis su gtan bde'i lam chen spel/ / rgyal khab phyi nang gnyis su mtshan snyan 'bar/ / rgya gar 'bar ma bal bo sing ga la/ / kum po dza sogs chos ldan rgyal khab kyi/ / sa skyong rnams kyis zhabs bsil mchod pa dang / / me tog phreng mdzes phul ba'i rnam thar brjid/ / ston pa'i drung du rgyal ri/sa

༄7/rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/'dus pa bzhin/ / cang ce hri dang ma'o tse tung gtso byas/ / rgya yi dpon chen mkhas chen mang bo zhig / chos khrid gnang ba'i gral du zhugs pa thos/ /thub pa'i zhal tshab rgyal paṇa rnam gnyis kyang / / gang la gus pa'i brtul zhugs dpe med bzung / paṇa chen bod don zhu yig khri bdun ma'ang / / gang gi phyag bris yin zhes kun gyis gleng / / rig gnas gsar brjer nag nyes khag bkal nas/ / btson dang bdeg brdung mnar gcod 'jig bskul kyang / /mi 'tsham mi 'os ma rabs spyod ngan la/ / drang srong bden pa'i tshig gis rgol bar byas/ / lha rams dge bshes dang po ming tsam min/ / don gyi phyag rjes rlabs chen 'gran bral bzhag / gzhung chen gnad gsang 'byin pa'i bka' rtsom dang / / smra ngan srog la rgol ba'i rtsod yig brjid/ / shes rab tā hri bstan pa'i snang byed che/ / mtshan gyi nyi 'od gling bzhi'i khyon kun khyab/ / bstan 'gror phan pa'i rlabs chen mdzad rjes ni/ /srid mtha'i bar du nyams shing brjed pa med/ / zhes pa 'di ni gangs can mkhas pa'i gzi dpal mtshungs zla med pa/ nges don gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros sku 'khrungs nas lo brgya dang nyer gnyis song ba'i spyi lo nyis stong dang nyag ma drug gi zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar ngo'i tshes la/ dam pa gang gi mdzad rnam rags bsdus rgya yig tu bsgyur ba dpar 'khod skabs/ yig sgyur mkhan gyi 'dod mos bzhin/ mtshams sbyor mtshon byed kyi tshigs bcad du dor zhi gdong drug snyems blor 'bod pas bris/ /2

da༅༅/ / rjegatsun dam pa shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam par tharab dun tshogs legs lam gyi rtse mo zhes bya5bakhubazhugs so/ /phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i gsung / / ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ /shākya'i gtso bo de la mgos phyag 'tshal/ / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa/ / blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / shes bya'i khyon dang mnyam pa'i blo gros kyis/ / rab 'byams lnga rig nam mdza'i mtha' 'jal ba/ / rgya chen 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mnga' bdag mchog / mtsho byung rol pa'i rdo rjor phyag 'tshal lo / rab 'byams gsung rab kun zlo lta ba'i mig / skal bzang thar bar bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog / brtse bas bskyod pa'i thabs mkhas mdzad pa yis/ /gsal mdzad bshes gnyen rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ / zhes pa byin rlabs kyi khyad/ mkhas pa'i yon tan nam mkha' la/ / mtha' ni thug pa yod min pa/ /de ni de bzhin de lta na'ang / / skra rtses blangs pa'i zil ba tsam sgro skur sprin gyis ma bsgribs shing / / chags snang rdul gyis ma dkrigs par/ /yang dag 'khrul med 'od stong gis/ /dam pa'i rnam thar gsal bar bya/1/

༄//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho rnam thar/de la 'dir rje bdag nyid chen pos lam rim chen mor/ jo bo chen po'i rnam thar mdzad pa na/ rigs phun sum tshogs par skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul/rten de la yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul/ brnyes nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul gsum du jo bo chen po'i yon tan 'gangs che rigs ma tshang ba med par 'dus pa rje'i dbongs par gnas pa bzhin/ 'dir yang sa bcad de gsum gyi sgo nas yang das pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i chen po rje btsun pra dz+nyā sa ra'i rnam par thar ba la gsum/ rigs phun sum tshogs par skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul/ rten de la yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul/ brnyes nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ yul mdo smad rdo sbis hor sprel ba dar gyi rigs las yab lha lung skyabs dang / yum lha lung skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing pho sprel lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar ngo'i rgyal ba gnyis pa ston pa thugs rje can mngon par 'byung ba'i dus khyad par can gyi gral tshes kyi skya rengs dang po shar ba dang dus mnyam du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po dang bcas te sku bltams so/ /ji ltar ngo mtshar pa'i tshul ni 'khrungs dus grod pa zhig gi nang du skyil krung gi tshul du byung zhing / lte thag phrag pa g.yas nas mchan khung g.yon du bcings te 'khrungs bar yul mi rgan rabs rnams kyis zer/ ltas ya mtshan can gzhan yang yul gyi mchod khang du rgyun gyi mchod me chung ngu zhig yod pa mtshan 'khyongs par 'bar ba sogs zer ba mang yang gzhan mi dran/ sku ngos kyi skye ba snga ma byis pa chung ngu gad pa bsnyil nas 'das pa zhig yin/ de glang zhig la zhon nas ma dang mnyam du 'ongs pa dran zhes rje rang nyid kyis gsungs/ yab yum gnyis snying rje che zhing dkon mardog la dad pa che ba/ g.yo sgyu med pa mi'i rang bzhin shin tu bzang ba zhig

༄/rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar phun tshogs legs lam gyi rtse mo/tu grags/ 'jigs byed bsnyen chen bcu gsum song ba'i mtshams pa rgya mtsho zer ba zhig gi skye ba yin zhes yul mi rgan rabs rnams kyis zer/ yang klu 'bum lha ris pa byang chub rab gsal zhes zhu ba/ tshig kha la byang ba tsam zhig las/ / don khongaX du chud pa ma mchis mod/ / ces gzhan rlo gsung 'phrin gnang ba'i tshig gi mgo rberjod 'di lta bu gnang ba des dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i tshe 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi zhing du mda' 'phangs pa ltar 'gro rgyu yin zhes gsungs pa sogs de lta bu'i rnam thar mang rabs shig rin po che nas gsungs pa mang mod mi dran zhing / rgyal dbang bcu gnyis pa'i mtshan zhabs mdo sngags rig gnas yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas grub chen po mdo dbus gtsang gsum kun na mtshan snyan shin tu rgyas pa zhig gi skye ba yin zhes zer ba yang mang / yang sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku skye yin zhes zer ba'ang mang / yang rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyi sprul ba yin zhes dbus gtsang kun la mthun par grags/'di dag sus sgrog 'dis sgrog med par mchog dman kun gyi kha na lhan skyes su grags pa zhig red/ de ltar grags pa yang / mkhas pa'i yon tan gyi cha nas parnyi ta dang mkhas dbang de dang de yin na rung pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin nam yang snyam/ khyad par du sngon hor gyi rgyal bos/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan rgya yul lang kru'u sde bzhir gdan drangs pa'i skabs shig gi tshe rgyal pos paṇ+ḍi ta la nyams sad dam/ kyal ka byas pa lta bu'i tshe rgyal pos/ khyod bod kyi ban+de kha brdar tsha zhes gsungs/ rin po ches nga la de'i gshes kyang cung zad yodagasungs pa 'dis sa skya parnyi ta'i sprul bar bston du med par zhal gyis bzhes pa lags so/ / 'di ni rigs phun sum tshogs par skye ba bzhes sna'i

༄//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/tshul rags tsam yin/gnyis pa rten de la yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ dgung lo bdun pa'i tshegazhung lugs rab 'byams la blo gros ches ma chog tu yangs pa lha rams pa nor bu rin po che nas rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par stsal te/shes rab rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ dge ldan 'phel rgyas gling gi chos sgor zhugs/ sum pa lha rams pa thogs med rin po che mchog nas yi ge phral klog sbyor klog sogs 'don chos sna tshogs dag par bslab pa sogs bka' drin chen pos gces par bskyangs/ dgung lo bcu drug pa'i tshe dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas de'i ston chos chen mor tshogs su zhugs / de'i tshe 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen shin tu zhan stabs rang yul gyi grwa rgan a khu dbu mdzad dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen a khu byams pa dang / sgang kha tshang gi dbon po rgan rgya'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang bcas pas zas gos sogs kyi mthun rkyen rogs ram gang zab snga phyi bar ma chad par gnang ba'i bka' drin che zhing /khyad par du dbon po rgan gya'i a khu dge 'dun rgya mtshos thog mar lha sar phebs skabs su khal g.yag gcig dang zla gnyis gsum tsam gyi lam rgyags dang bcas rdzogs sta mdzad pa'i bka' drin lhag par che/ de'i khal g.yag dngul rwa nas mi tan can zhig la phyir 'phrod nges su bskur ba yin gsungs/mthun rkyen de dag la brten nas rang gis kyang slob gnyer la nyin mtshan sbrel ba'i brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rgyun mi 'chad par byas pa yin gsungs/dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po a khu the bo dkon mchog dge rgan du bsten te/bsdus grwa blo rtags sogs kyi rigs lam shin tu byang bar bslabs/ de tshe bse bzhis grwa dang blo rtags mtha' dpyod gnyis/ 'grel ba don gsal/ rgyan

༄cu//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar phun tshogs legs lam gyi rtse mo/'jug gnyis bcas de'i chos thog rjes ma la tshogs rgyug tu phul pas/ lo de'i dgun chos chen mor dmigs bsal gyis 'dzin grwa gong du spar pa sogs grwa rgan gzhon tshang mas ngo mtshar chen po byed/ khyad par du bshes gnyen chen po a khu gung thang blo gros tshang la legs bshad snying po/ grub 'grel kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma rtsa 'grel/ khong rang nas bka' rtsom mdzad pa'i mdzod gnas brgyad kyi bshad lung dang / 'dul 'dzin rin po che'i bslab bya gnam rtse ldang ma sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ 'jam bzhad sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug zhal snga nas mchog la rgyan 'jug gi ljags lung sogs gsan/ yang a lags sgo mang rin po che tshul khrims rgya mtsho mchog la khong nas bka' rtsom mdzad pa'i rgyan drug phyag mchod sogs chos bka' sna tshogs gsan/ a lags bde thang rin po che la 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo dang /grub mtha' rtsa ba'i ljags lung sogs gsan/ khyad par du a khu gung thang blo gros tshang la da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan por gsol ba btab ste dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par mnos/ dus skabs der bla ma de gsum bka' chos sna tshogs kyi rgyun spel 'chad nyan gyi khungs gtugs sa'i gtso bor grags che/ rin po che nas/ khyod kyis dbu ma chen mo byang chub tu/ / bzung yod snyam pa'i re ba byed nges zhes/ / brtse ba'i zhal gdams sha tsha'i rus pa can/ / da lta dran na dad pa'i spu long ldan / /sogs gsungs pa ltar/ lhag par a khu blo gros tshang nas/ khyod 'dir bsdad na khyod kyi shes rab phun sum tshogs pa de lad rgyu red/ de bas dbus su phebs na dgos don che zhing bstan 'gror phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur zhes skul ma nan cher gnang zhing / de dang mthun par a lags sgo mang /na

༄//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/po che nas/ dbus su phyin na shin tu legs pas dmigs brtse ma 'bum ther gcig 'phral sgrub kyis song dang legs lam che zhes pa'i bka' stsal dang du blangs te/ dgung lo nyer gcig gi tshe lha sar phebs/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos sgor zhugs/ zhal nas/ mdo dbus bkra shis sgo mang gi /dam pa rgyal ba'i thugs 'chang zhing / / skal bzang bung ba'i 'phro 'du can/ /legs bshad pad sdong du ma bsten/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sngags rig gnas yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po sog po'i dge bshes mchog grub dkar bo zhu ba dge rgan du bsten/ khyad par du paṇa chen byams pa gling ba bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i sku'i skye bar grags che ba'i bla ma 'bul sdud rin po che blo bzang ye shes bsten pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchogasbyi po'i cod pan du bkur te gzhung khrid mang du zhus/ chos grwa'i rtsod pa dang / chos mtshams su gzhung gi 'dzin khrid sogs la nyin mtshan sbrel ba'i brtson 'grus bar ma chad pa byas gsungs/ sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos ra'i 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon mdzad pa na mkhan pos brtsi gzhag ring thung ji ltar gnang ba bzhin 'phral du chad lhag med par sgra dag gsal gsum gyi sgo nas skyor ba sogs kyi khyad chos gzhan la med pa yang mang / de'i tshe 'dzin grwa yar gtugs mar gtugs kyi tshe yang gtso bo mdzad de rtsod rigs myur zhing rno ba dang tshig gi brjod pa gtsang bas rgan gzhon kun gyi yid 'phrogs pas sku na phra ba zhig la 'di 'dra ang / zhes thams cad ngo mtshar chen po byed/ de skad du zhalanas kyang / khong rul yig 'bru'i sgrom min par/ / phra zhib rigs lam dung gi sgras/ / ma rig mthug por log pa'i gnyid/ / bdas ba'i mig ni dpal dang 'grogs/ / zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe blo 'dzin yang legs bshad

༄༅//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar phun tshogs legs lam gyi rtse mo/la yul lugs dang mthun pa'i maṇ+ḍal mi dgos kyi/ rigs pas dpyod tshul mang po zhus pa la dgongs 'gal med par zhu zhus par/ de la bla ma 'bul sdud rin po che nas/ 'brug brgya yis lhag pa'i seṅge khyod/ / bu ras chung zer ba'i bzhin legs po/ / tshe 'di bas phyi ma gal che zhing / / dus da lta khyams ra gal che'o/ / zhes mi la yab sras kyi gsung mgur gyi tshul du sku rtsed mdzad nas khyod ston chen ngar langs pa'i kha rgan po bdag gis gang nas chod/ nga rgan po ma ṇi 'don du chug hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes gsungs pa sogs kyang mdzad pa la/rin po che nas/ rang rgyud kyi don dgag bya la ma sbyar bar rang rgyud yod pa'i phyogs kyi dpyod tshul mang du zhus pa la thugs ma dgyes 'dug snyam nas thugs shin tu pham ste/ spyan chab dang bcas phyag mang du 'tshal nas bla ma rin po che thugs dgyes snyam pa ma gtogs nga rgyal gyi bsam pa spu tsam yang med mod/tshe 'di bas phyi ma gal che gsungs pa 'dis bla ma thugs ma dgyes par thag chod snyam ste/ sems kyis bzod thabs mi 'dug zhus pas/ bla mas de gtan nas min zhes yang yang gsungs pa 'di 'dra'ang byung / grwa tshang gi 'gag ring thung gi dam bca' sogs kyi tshe/ rigs lung la bzhengs na yang snga ma'i rtags gsal gyi 'phro skyor ba las/ rtags gsal gsar 'dzugs mi gnang / de'i yang rtsod rigs shin tu rno la myur ba dang / gsung gi brjod pa gtsang zhing shin tu snyan pa/ mkhas pa'i skye bo kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i khyad chos mang du yod/ grwa tshang gi chos grwa'i mtshan phud sna tshogs dang / chos mtshams chen mo'i khams tshan so so'i mtshan phud dam bca' sogs la yang phebs te rtsod pa rtsod lugs 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i slob ston dang 'brel bar rtsod pa rgyun chags su gnang bas rgan gzhon kun gyis re mthong che ba ltar dgung ༵ so

༄/rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho rnam thar/bdud sde zil gnon/ mi 'khrugs pa'i 'bum pa sogs bzhengs te/ gdan 'dren zhus nas phul ba na/ mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun gzigs 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bslu med bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshe rabs kun tu thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs/ / snying nas dad pa dang ldan pa don 'grub rgya mtsho'i mos pa'i ngor/'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis spel/ dza yachu/ zhes pa'i tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi tshigs bcad dang / pha tshe mgon skyabs dang / ma dang / nye 'brel dag la yang thugs smon mang du mdzad/ gzhan yang dbu mdzad don 'grub nas chos rar sdings gur legs pa zhig bzos te grwa tshang rin po cher lo de'i dgu ba'i bco lnga'i nyin rin po che dang grwa tshang tshogs yongs dang bcas pa lung rigasasgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i dga' tshal du 'tshogs te/ rin po che la maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang 'dus pa rgya mtshor 'gyed mang ja legs pa zhig dang bcas 'bul lam zhus shing / de'i nyin dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sngags rams pa thub bstan snying rje dang / nged gnyis tshogs langs kyis zhes rin po che nas gsungs pa ltar gzhung chos 'khor dang / 'phrin las kyi bgro gleng btang /rin po che tshogs yongs dang bcas pas dbu mdzad don 'grub pha ma nye 'khor dang bcas pa la legs lam 'ong ba'i thugs smon zhal 'don mang du mdzad pa na/ de nyin 'brug grags pa'i rtags ya mtshan can 'ga' re yang byung /sngags rams pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po thub bstan snying rje nas/rin po che'i gsung 'bum po ti gnyis kyi bshad lung zhus pa theg chen chos kyi gan mdzod nas grwa tshang dge 'dun mang la gnang / rin po che'i dge rgan lha za~X pa thogs med rin po che'i sprul sku skal bzang bstan pa dar rgyas nas grwa

༄/rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar phun tshogs legs lam gyi rtse mo/tshang rin po cher tshogs gur che legs mtshar sdug cig phul ba'i nyin/ rin po che gdan drangs te gsol ja phul ba'i rjes su grwa tshang dang rin po che la 'di las gzhan 'bul rgyu med/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su gzung dugasol zhus rjes su/ phan pa'i lan du re ba'i mchod pa ni/ / bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin nyams su len pa dgos/ / zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gsungs/bla ma nor bu rin po che'i yang sprul khyed gar phebs gar bzhugs su rje 'bangs sha zhen nam yang mi lhod cing / bstan 'gro'i phan bde spyi dang khyad par grwa tshang rin po che'i zhabs 'degs mdzad bzang g.yel ba med par 'tshal/shākya'i dge sbyong shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis bris/zhes sogs phyag bris 'ga' zhig snga phyir gnang ba'i rjes shig na phyir phebs te/rin po cher gsol ja zhig drangs te skyabs mjug zhus don/ bdag la rin po che dang grwa tshang rin po che la zhabs zhu yang dag cag sgrub pa'i nus mthu ma mchis rung dge 'dun mang la 'o ma'i rgyun dang / mar rgyun zhig btsugs te lha khang so sor rgyun gyi mchod me re dang mang ja gzhan du 'tshol mi dgos pa zhig bya snyam pa rgyun du 'char yang / de ltar 'grub pa'i skal ba yod dam thugs smon skyabs 'jug zhus lan du/ rin po che nas de shin tu legs/sngon sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe dbul mo bsnyen dga' mos nyin gcig gi ring phyogs phyogs su slong ba'i gser gyi dong tshe gcig gis mar nyos te sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang du mar me gcig phul ba'i bsod nams kyis ma 'ongs pa'i dus su mar me 'od ces bya ba'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan pa bzhin du de dang rigs mthun gyi bsod nams shig tu 'gyur bar the tshom med/ ces bla ma'i sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin rdi snatsho

༄//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/la gsungs/ srung ma khyad par can dung ri 'od ldan gyi rten mkhar gsar du bzhengs te/ yul spyi dang khyad par chos sde 'di'i phyi nang snod bcud gang cir srung skyob g.yel med dgos pa'i 'phrin bcol mang du mdzad/ shes par bya ba'i gnas la thogs med cing / / rab 'byams gzhung mang smra ba'i glog lce 'khyug / rgya chen grags snyan nam mdza'i mthar son pa/ / mtsho byung bzhad pa'i zhabs la bsol ba 'debs/ / dge slong grags pa thogs rmid kyi zhus pa ltar gnang / yang grwa mang la rgyun gyi nyams bzhes bya tshul gnang ba/ oṃ su sti/nam langs pa nas rang sems la shes bzhin gyis lta rtog ma lhod par nyal kha'i bar bsam pa bzang ba gzhir bzung thog rnam 'grel yan chad tshang mas nyin bzhin/ skyabs 'gro dmigs brtse ma/ a ra pa tsa brgya re ma chags/gzhung gsar skabs gnyis pa dbu ma gsum gyis nang don gang 'os la rang gi blo tshod kyis slob gnyer dang / mdzod 'dul gnyis kyis brgya rtsa/ su ru ba/za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg phyag dang skor ba re ma chag par gyis/ gzhung gsar man gyis slob grwa hur brtson dang / tshang mas mdo sngags lam rim blo sbyong dang / sdom pa gsum dang / lam gtso gsum la dpyad sgom re ma chags par gyis shig thugs mthun 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'phyur bar mdzod/ ces gsungs/ grwa ba mthun rkyen zhan pa rnams la gzan sham dang sgor cha re gnang ba'ang mang / de bzhin du khyim pa pho mo 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen zhan pa mang po la yang sgor 'ga' re dang / zas gos sogs gnang ba yang mang / rgyun du grwa tshang du bzhugs skabs dpe khrid/ bka' chos/ bslab bya sogs rgyun par grwa tshang dge 'dun mang la gnang / tho rgya'i dge bshes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho nas rtenā /brel bstod pa'i bshad lung zhus pa gnas brtan lha khang nas grwa tshang

༄༅khes rab rgya mtsho mchog gi mdzad rnam gsal bsdus/spyi lo1899lor/ dgung lo bcu drug la son/ lo 'di'i ston kur a mdo bla brang bkra shes 'khyil 'grims/ der bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas rim paradage ba'i bshes gnyen gung thang blo gros rgya mtsho dang kun mkhyen bzhi ba chen mo skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug sgo mang rin po che tshul khrims rgya mtsho tshang / bde thang bla ma dang bshes gnyen chen po the bo dkon mchog sogs bsten te rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi bstan bcos dag la thos bsam gnang / lo 'dir khong gi thugs sras lha rams pa skal bzang rgya mtsho sku 'khrungs/spyi lo1900lor/ dgung lo bcu bdun la pon/ tshad ma'i rigs lam la rim gyis go ba rnyed cing bse ngag dbang bkra shis kyi bsdus grwa dang blo rtags mtha' dpyod gnyis/ 'grel ba don gsal bcas la slob gnyer gnang zhing lo de'i chos thog rjes mar tshogs rgyugs legs par phul bas grwa bgres mang po ngo mtshar zhing dmigs bsal kyis 'dzin grwa spar ba sogs byung /spyi lo1901lor/ dgung lo bco brgyad la son/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gung thang blo gros rgya mtsho la 〈legs bshad snying po〉dang 〈grub 'grel kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma'i rtsa 'grel 〉khong rang nyid nas bka' rtsom mdzad pa'i 〈mdzod gnas brgyad kyi bshad lung 〉dang 〈dbu ma 'jug pa〉sogs gsan cing / sgo mang bla ma rin po che tshul khrims rgya mtsho la 〈rgyan drug phyag mchod〉gsan/spyi lo1902lor/ dgung lo bcu dgu la son/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas mu mthud slob gnyer gyi 'phro skyangs zhing bde thang bla ma rin po che la 〈'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po〉dang 〈grub mtha' rtsa ba〉gsan/ 75

༄//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/spyi lo1903lor/ dgung lo nyi shur son/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gung thang blo gros rgya mtsho la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ (dgung lo nyer brgyad steng yin nam brtag par bya'o)spyi lo1904lor/ dgung lo nyer gcig la son/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gung thang blo gros rgya mtsho dang sgo mang bla ma rin po che rnam gnyis kyis bka' bsgos bzhin dbus su slob gnyer du phebs shing der bla brang sgang kha tshangagi dbon po rgan kyu'i dge 'dun rgya mtshos khal g.yag gcig dang zla ngo gnyis tsam gyi lam rgyags dang bcas rdzongs sta mdzad pa yin la khal g.yag de lha sar 'byor rjes a mdo dngul rwa'i mi tan can zhig la 'phrod nges su bskur/'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs te bla ma yongs 'dzin 'bul sdud rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang mchog grub dkar po gnyis dge rgan du bsten cing gzhung chen pod lngar gsan sbyong gnang /spyi lo1905lor/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la son/ gzhung chen pod lngar gsan sbyong gnang zhor du 〈legs bshad snying po 〉dang 〈legs bshad gser phreng snyamada' tshad ma bdun re nyin rgyun chag med du thugs 'dzin gnang /spyi lo1906lor/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la son/ 'bras spungs su slob gnyer gnang dus 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen shin tu zhan pas khri zam pa ra gzhis ka zhes pa'i mi tshang chen po zhig tu rim gror phebs dus rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gyi par gzhi las 'dul ba'i skor shog grangs nyin srib par nor brgyab pa ngos zin pas gzhis ka 'di'i khyim mi yongs kyis khong la rje rin po che dardoswā lta bu'i dad pa dag snang skyes zhing de nas bzung khong gi 'tsho ba'i mthun

༄༅khes rab rgya mtsho mchog gi mdzad rnam gsal bsdus/rkyen la dka' tshegs gang yang ma byung bar slob gnyer rnal ma kho na byed thub pa'i go skabs byung /spyi lo1907lor/ dgung lo nyer bzhir son/ sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos rwa'i skyor dpon mdzad/spyi lo1908lor/ dgung lo nyer lngar son/ mu mthun du 'bras spungs su slob gnyer gnang /spyi lo1909lor/ dgung lo nyer drug la son/ gung ru mkhan chen mkhyen rab bstan pa chos 'phel tshang la rje yab sras gsum ga'i gsung 'bum gyi ljags lung dang gsung 'bum re gnyis sheg gi chad bsab bshes gnyen chen po bka' 'gyur ba bla ma blo bzang don ldan mchog la gsan/spyi lo1910lor/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la pon/ mu mthud du 'bras spungs su slob gnyer mdzad/spyi lo1911lor/ dgung lo nyer brgyad la son/ 'bras srungs su slob gnyer gnang zhor 'jang dgun chos dang gsang phu dbyar chos sogs la chag med du phyin pas rtsod rigs shin tu myur ba'i snyan grags kyis sa steng khyab/(khong gis bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes lo 'di yin yang snyam)spyi lo1912lor/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu la son/ mu mthud du 'bras spungs su slob gnyer gnang bzhin khong dang dge rgan 'bul sdud rin po che gnyis kyis dbu ma rang rgyud pa la rtags yod med skor gyi bgro gleng gnang bas bla slob dam tshig gtsang ma'i dad sems mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i rnam thar byung /spyi lo1913lor/ dgung lo sum cur son/ mu mthud du 'bras spungs su slob gnyer gnang / 77

༄cu//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/spyi lo1914lor/ dgung lo sum cu so gcig la son/ mu mthun du 'bras spungs su slob gnyer gnang /spyi lo1915lor/ dgung lo sum cu so gnyis la son/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dang tha snyad rig gnas kun la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral bas sgo mang grwa tshang du lha rams 'phar ma'i cho lo thob pa dang nor gling rtsod rgyugs kyi tshe ang dang po byung /spyi lo1916lor/ dgung lo sum cu so gsum la son/ rtse po ta la'i gzims chung chen mor dmigs bsal gyis tshogs langs gnang / lo de'i smon lam chen mo'i steng lha rams pa'i legs nyes kyi dam bca' bsgrigs dus khong nyid ang dang po byung / lo de'i sa ga zla ba nas dbu tshugs te rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'bum par gsar bsgrigs kyi zhu dag gi 'gan bzhes/spyi lo1917lor/ dgung lo sum cu so bzhir son/ nor gling spyan gsal pho brang du bu ston gsung 'bum gyi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi zhu dag gnang /spyi lo1918lor/ dgung lo sum cu so lngar son/ mu mthud du bu ston gsung 'bum par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi zhu dag gnang /spyi lo1919lor/ dgung lo sum cu so drug la son/ mu mthud du bu ston gsung 'bum par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi zhu dag gnang ba dang lo 'dir rgya nag pe dbyang srid gzhung bod rgya mthun 'brel gyi pho nya ba mdo smad dgu rong bla ma dang nor bu gling gar lhan 'dzoms byung /78spyi lo1920lor/ dgung lo sum cu so bdun la son/ mu mthud du bu

༄༅khes rab rgya mtsho mchog gi mdzad rnam gsal bsdus/ston gsung 'bum gyi par gzhir zhu dag gnang /spyi lo1921lor/ dgung lo sum bcu so brgyad la son/ gong sa rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshor zhus pa bzhin khong gi bla ma lcang shar sprul sku thub bstan dge 'dun gyi yang srid ngos 'dzin byung /spyi lo1922lor/ dgung lo sum cu so dgur zin/ lo ngo drug tsam gyi dka' tshegs rtsol ba la brten nas bu ston gsung 'bum par gzhi gsar bzhengs legs grub byung /spyi lo1923lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcur son/ bu ston gsung 'bum par gsar legs grub byung bar brten rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho thugs shin tu dgyes shing rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi zhu dag 'os 'gan khong gi gnang dgos pa'i bka' mngags bzhin bka' bstsal dang du blangs te las 'di'i dbu tshugs shing phyag rogs stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab/ tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang dang yer pa bcas yod/spyi lo1924lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig la son/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las gnang /spyi lo1925lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis la son/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las gnang /spyi lo1926lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum la son/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las gnang / nyin bcu drug gi yun du 〈rta tshag rnam thar bsam 'phel nor bu' bang mdzod〉sbyar/spyi lo1927lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhir pon/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las gnang / 79

༄༅//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/spyi lo1928lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe lngar son/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las gnang / spyi lo1929lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe drug la son/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las gnang /spyi lo1930lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun la son/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par gzhi gsar bzhengs kyi phyag las mjug zin/spyi lo1931lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad la son/ 'bras spungs klu 'bum khams tshan gyi lnga rig nor bu'i lding khang du bzhugs mur khams tshan dang grwa tshang gzhan ci rigs kyi slob gnyer ba tshor dpe khrid gnang /spyi lo1932lor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgur son/ 'bras spungs klu 'bum tshoms chen dang dge 'phel ri khrod sogs su slob gnyer pa mang por chos bka' ci rigs gnang /spyi lo1933lor/ dgung lo lnga bcur son/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen po glo bur du sku gshegs pa dang mi rje tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul gyis gsung bskul bzhin gong sa rgyal ba'i mdzad rnam 〈gsol 'debs pad ma dkar po'i 'khri shing 〉zhes pa mdzad pa dang sge'u stong yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan gyi 〈rtsod yig rigs pa'i gad rgyangs〉la dgag lan 〈bskal ba'i me dpung 〉zhes pa mdzad/spyi lo1934lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig la son/ mtsho sngon zi ling bod yig zhib 'jug khang gi dbu 'dzin lis tan dang yang kri h+phu'u dang 'ig yung kri gsum lha sar 'byor cing sde pa gzhung gi bka' bkod bzhin khong gi sadī spyad yig slob gnyer du thon par khong gis byang chub lam rim chen mo nas

༄༅//shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gi mdzad rnam gsal bsdus/ dbu tshugs te dpe khrid gnang /spyi lo1935lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis la pon/ khong nyid rgya nag rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung gis gdan 'dren zhu bzhin yod na'ang grwa sa dang ri khrod gang rung du dpe khrid gnang mus su bzhugs pa dang / lha sa'i lho rgyud kyi gnas ri mang por mchod mjal du phebs shing lha mo bla mtshor 'byung 'gyur mtshon pa'i gzugs brnyan mang du mjal/spyi lo1936lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum la son/ 'bras spungs nas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba chos kyi nyi ma mchog rgya nag nas bod du phebs bzhud mdzad na legs tshul gyi zhu yig phul ba dang lo smad du lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi lho rgyud kyi dgon shod bla brang du bzhugs/spyi lo1937lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhir son/ lo 'dir khong gi thugs sras lha rams pa skal bzang rgya mtshos lha sa'i smon lam chen mo'i steng lha rams pa'i rtsod rgyugs dam bca' gnang / krung hwa rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung gis yang yang gdan 'dren gnang ba bzhin khong dang lha rams pa skal bzang rgya mtsho/ lis tan dang yang kri h+phu'u/ dgon gsar sprul sku thub bstan 'jigs bral dang lha sa'i sde pa gzhung gi yig sgyur pa nor bu tshe ring gi bu gsum dang lhan du khong sku 'khor lhan rgyas lo 'dir lha sa nas rgyang rtse dang ka lon sbug brgyud rgya gar du phebs pa dang de nas gru gzings la bzhugs hang gang dang rim gyis nan cin du 'byor/ cang ce hri gtsos pa'i mtho rim mi sna mang bo zhig dang mjal 'phrad gnang / rgyal btsugs slob chen lnga ru bod kyi rig gnas skor kyi gsung khrid gnang / zla ba bdun par 'khrungs yul rdo sbis su zhabs sor 'khod/ skabs 'dir rgya gar du slob gnyer rtog zhib /spyang

༄//rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/bzhin pa'i khong gi slob bu dge 'dun chos 'phel dang ka li ka tar mjal 'dzoms byung /spyi lo1938lor/ dgung lo lnga cu nga lngar son/ nan cin du chos srid don chen gang mang la gros gzhi bgro gleng gnang / 'jar 'gog dmag 'khrug khrod dge 'dun pa dag kyang zhugs dgos pa'i gros gzhi bton par khong nyid nas dgag pa gnang pa dang dge 'dun pa'i sde rnams bag yod du bzhugs thub pa'i khas len zhal 'ches khong nyid kyis bzhes/spyi lo1939lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga drug la son/ 〈yang dag pa'i gtam pad+ma dkar po'i ge sar〉mdzad/ rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung slob gso pu'u dang bod sog u yon lhan khang gi bka' bkod bzhin mdo smad kyi dgon chen bla brang dang / co rna dgon/ bya khyung / sdis tsha/ rong bo dgon/gser khog chu bzang / dgon lung / dpa' ris mchod rten thang /'dan ma grub chen dgon/ rang btags lung ba'i dgon/ la mo bde chen dang dmar gtsang sgrub phug khri ku'i o jo dgon/ jo khang / mnga' bdag khri ral gyi mchod rten/ lo rdo rje brag dang snang ra'i gser khang sogs sgrub sde mang por ched phebs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len dang lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan gong 'phel yong bar rlabs chen thugs smon dang zhal slob gnang zhing dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor 'jar 'gog dmag 'khrug zhi 'jags la chos mthun legs mdzad bskyangs rgyu'i 'bod skul gnang la bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen che chung mang bo dang mjal 'dzoms byung la rong bo dgon du sge'u steng yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan dkā sprasung gleng mjal 'dzoms byas/

༄༅//shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gi mdzad rnam gsal bsdus/spyi lo1940lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga bdun son/ rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung gis khong la bstan pa'i rogs mgon sgrol ston bsam gtan gyi slob dpon zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gnang /spyi lo1941lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga brgyad la son/ khong gis rgyal 'bangasasrid gzhung slob gso pu'u la yar zhu mdzad pa ltar 'khrungs yul rdo sbos su mtsho sngon rgyal bstan btsun pa'i blo sbyong khang gsar 'dzugs dang khong gis dbu 'dzin gnang /spyi lo1942lor/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga dgur son/ mtsho sngon rgyal bstan btsun pa'i blo sbyong khang dbu tshugs pa'i mdzad sgo bsdus shing khong gis gal che'i bka' slob gnang /spyi lo1943lor/ dgung lo drug cur son/ rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung gi bka' mngags bzhin zla ngo drug tsam gyi dka' ba spyad de bod du 'tshams zhur phebs kyang nag chu nas lha sa'i sde pa gzhung gis bkag bzlog byas pa bzhin phyir phebs/ 〈sku 'bum bstod pa 'jam mgon bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod sprin〉mdzad/spyi lo1944lor/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig la son/ rgya nag khron chin du bzhugs/spyi lo1945lor/ dgung lo drug cu re gnyis la son/ rgyal 'bangs srid gzhung gi krung dbyang u yon gyi srid 'gan bzhes/ 〈brag dkar sprel rdzong gi bstod pa g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgra dbyangs〉brtsams/spyi lo1946lor/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum la son/ go min tang tshogs chen gyi 'thus mir bdams thon byung / 83
